summary.text: Ashley Webb is an independent artist, published author and patient advocate from Farmington, Maine, running as a certified write-in Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate. She sought the Democratic nomination after Graham Platner withdrew and took part in a televised debate before the party chose Troy Jackson.

paragraphs.text: Describes herself as an independent artist, published author and patient advocate from Farmington, Maine.
Sought the Democratic nomination to replace Graham Platner and took part in one televised debate for it; Ballotpedia says she lost at the July 25, 2026 convention, which Troy Jackson won.
Filed as a declared write-in candidate for the November 2026 general election; the race uses ranked-choice voting.
